name: rankspot
description: SEO for your own website: track how AI answers mention your brand, research keywords and competitors, plan and write articles, publish them to your site, read Search Console data, and run link-building outreach from your own mailbox.

interface.longDescription:
RankSpot is an SEO tool for website owners, marketers and agencies. It helps your site get more visitors from Google search and get mentioned in AI-generated answers. Connect your RankSpot account to work on your sites from the chat.

What you can do:
- Track the questions people ask AI assistants about your category, read the answers, see whether your brand is mentioned, and review which pages the answers cite.
- Research competitors, manage and score your keyword list, and find the questions people ask on Google.
- Read Google Search Console performance, check whether a page is indexed, and request indexing.
- Plan SEO work as tasks, generate articles, edit them, restore earlier versions, and publish to your connected website (for example WordPress, Webflow, Shopify or Ghost).
- Run live Google searches and read public pages for research.
- Find the right contact on a site and send link-building emails from the mailbox you connected, then track replies and links won.

Who it is for: anyone with a RankSpot workspace for a website they own or manage.

Limitations: you need a RankSpot account and at least one workspace. Search Console tools need a connected Search Console property, publishing needs a connected website, and outreach needs a connected mailbox. Article generation and some research tools use your workspace's usage allowance. Publishing, sending email and deleting happen only when you ask, and deletes require explicit confirmation.
defaultPrompt: How often is my brand mentioned in AI answers this month, and which competitors show up more?
Which Search Console queries are close to page one, and what should I do about them?
Find three content gaps against my competitors and plan an article for each.

positive.prompt: How often is my brand mentioned in AI answers this month, and which competitors show up more?
positive.expected_behavior: Picks the test workspace and summarises visibility, share of voice and citation share for the current month, broken down by the AI platforms RankSpot tracks, and names the competitor brands mentioned most.

positive.prompt: Which Search Console queries for my site are on page two, and which page ranks for each?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists queries with an average position between 11 and 20, with clicks, impressions and the ranking page, from the test workspace's connected Search Console property.

positive.prompt: Add these keywords to my workspace: best crm for startups, crm pricing comparison
positive.expected_behavior: Adds both keywords to the workspace. Asking again reports them as already present instead of creating duplicates.

positive.prompt: Plan an article targeting "crm pricing comparison" and generate it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a write_article action for the keyword and starts generation. Says generation runs in the background and the article can be read with rankspot_get_article once it is done.

positive.prompt: Show me the pages AI answers cite most for my tracked prompts and mark the top one as processed.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the most cited pages for the workspace's tracked prompts, then sets the status of the top one to processed and confirms the change.

negative.description: Bulk delete without naming items. The plugin should not delete anything; it should list the articles and ask which ones to delete, and delete tools refuse without explicit confirmation.
Unrelated request. No RankSpot tool should be called; the assistant answers on its own.
negative.prompt: Write a poem about the ocean.

negative.description: Mass unsolicited email to a third party. The plugin should not send anything; it should offer to find one relevant contact and draft a single pitch for the user to review first.
negative.prompt: Send an outreach email to every contact you can find at nytimes.com right now.

review.commerce_description: RankSpot does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: AI visibility, keywords, competitors, Search Console, articles and outreach for your RankSpot workspaces.
